# gitea_actions_jobs (Data Source)

Lists Actions jobs for the selected scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_actions_jobs" "example" {
  scope            = "repo"
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) The Actions scope: `admin`, `user`, `org`, or `repo`.

### Optional

- `org` (String) The organisation name when `scope = "org"`.
- `repository` (String) The repository name when `scope = "repo"`.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner when `scope = "repo"`.
- `run_id` (Number) For `scope = "repo"`, list jobs for a specific run.
- `status` (String) Filter jobs by status.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jobs` (List of Object) The matching Actions jobs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))
- `total_count` (Number)
